defs.def: to refuse to accept or consider sth 拒绝接受；不予考虑

ex.s: We could rephrase it like this: understand the wisdom in past decisions before you reject them.
ex.t: 但对"既有做法"不加批判的盲目遵从也可能使我们失去拥有更好日子的可能性。

ex.s: When I was rejected from one that had seemed like a perfect fit, it was undoubtedly difficult.
ex.t: 当我被一个看似完美契合的职位拒绝时，无疑很难受。

ex.s: A rejection can be a redirection.
ex.t: 拒绝可能是一种重新指引。

ex.s: When contributions were made by geniuses outside the club—women, or people of a different color or belief—they were unacknowledged and rejected by others.
ex.t: 当俱乐部之外的天才——女性，或不同肤色或信仰的人——做出贡献时，他们的贡献不被承认，反而被他人拒绝。
莉莉拒绝了一份工作邀请

ex.s: It’s jaw-dropping how much perfectly good food is thrown away — from “ugly” (but quite eatable) vegetables rejected by grocers to large amounts of uneaten dishes thrown into restaurant garbage cans.
ex.t: 完美完好的食物被扔掉的数量令人震惊——从杂货商拒绝的"丑陋"（但完全可以食用）的蔬菜到大量被扔进餐厅垃圾桶的剩菜。

ex.s: It takes considerable courage to reject the easy and familiar and instead try to live closer to nature, as both Tao and Thoreau did.
ex.t: 拒绝轻松和熟悉的事物，转而尝试更贴近自然地生活，正如陶渊明和梭罗所做的那样，这需要相当大的勇气。

ex.s: Jenny: Well, I wouldn’t reject anything out of hand.
ex.t: 珍妮：嗯，我不会不假思索地拒绝任何事情。

ex.s: Dr Lin, however, rejected the offer.
ex.t: 然而，林博士拒绝了这个邀请。

ex.s: Welcome or reject future changes UNIT 2 LOOKING INTO THE FUTURE 2 Answer the following questions about the text.
ex.t: 欢迎还是拒绝未来的变化 第二单元 展望未来 2 回答以下关于课文的问题。

ex.s: However, modern poets began to reject traditional forms and structures for poetry in the 20th century.
ex.t: 然而，现代诗人在20世纪开始拒绝诗歌的传统形式和结构。

ex.s: In my ninth-grade writing class last year, I met a cowboy who saved his town, a strict father who demanded his son earn straight A’s, and a modern-day Juliet who died of heartbreak after her parents rejected the love of her young life.
ex.t: 去年在我九年级的写作课上，我遇到了一个拯救了小镇的牛仔、一个要求儿子门门得A的严厉父亲，以及一个在现代版朱丽叶——她在父母拒绝了她年轻生命中的挚爱后，因心碎而死。

defs.def: to refuse to accept sb for a job, position, etc. 拒收；不录用；拒绝接纳
to decide not to use, sell, publish, etc. sth because its quality is not good enough （因质量差）不用，不出售，不出版

ex.s: Things like kale ribs, fish collars, rejected sweet potatoes, and cucumber butts were all re-appropriated and, with the help of a number of good chefs, turned into excellent cuisine.
ex.t: 像羽衣甘蓝梗、鱼颈肉、被挑拣出的红薯和黄瓜屁股这类东西，都被重新利用，并在几位好厨师的帮助下，变成了极好的菜肴。

defs.def: to not accept a new organ after a transplant operation, by producing substances that attack the organ 身体
to fail to give a person or an animal enough care or affection 不够关心；慢待
something that cannot be used or sold because there is sth wrong with it 废品；次品
a person who has not been accepted as a member of a team, society, etc. 不合格者；被剔除者；被拒收者

ex.s: I had put so much time and emotional energy into applying, and I thought the rejection meant the end of the road for my science career.
ex.t: 我在申请上投入了那么多时间和情感精力，我以为那封拒信意味着我的科学事业走到了尽头。
